title: Hardware calculators: the math behind the westlakesys.com electronics calculators
description: Plain TypeScript, with test vectors, for everyday board-design calculations: battery life, radio range, crystal load capacitors, NTC thermistor dividers, PCB trace width, PCB impedance, voltage dividers, coin cell pulse loads, L-network matching and I2C pull-up resistors. Each calculator is interactive at https://westlakesys.com/tools/.
